## README

# Send As Alias - Thunderbird Extension

Automatically manage email aliases with support for multiple alias methods:
- **Plus-addressing**: `user+alias@domain.com` (Gmail, Posteo, etc.)
- **Own domain**: `alias@yourdomain.com` (domains you own)
- **Catchall**: `anything@yourdomain.com` (domains with catchall forwarding)

> **Initial setup required:** after installation the extension is inactive until
> you enable **Reply as Alias** for at least one account in the extension settings
> and select its alias method — all features are opt-in per account. The
> settings page opens automatically after installation; see
> Configuration.

## Features

### Reply as Alias 📧 Per-Account (Opt-In)

Automatically sets your "From" address to match aliases when replying to or forwarding emails.

**Examples:**

*Plus-addressing:*
- You receive an email sent to `user+shopping@posteo.de`
- You click Reply → From is set to `user+shopping@posteo.de`

*Own domain:*
- You receive an email sent to `sales@yourdomain.com`
- You click Reply → From is set to `sales@yourdomain.com`

**Works with:** Reply, Reply All, and Forward

# A toolbox for the email you already use. 

 Maskwire is an IMAP/SMTP proxy between your mail app and your provider. Enable tools for alias replies, sender rewriting, text redaction, and more. 

One tool free. All tools for $3/month.

## Your mail app

Keep the client you use

 maskwire Your toolbox 

 Reply from the receiving alias Rewrite sender addresses Redact matching text Archive instead of delete 

Example tools. You choose what runs.

## Your email provider

Your mailbox stays here

Connected over IMAP and SMTP. Tools run as mail passes through.

## No bullshit, tell me what Maskwire does.

You point your mail app at Maskwire. Maskwire connects to your upstream email server and applies the tools you enable as messages and commands pass through. Your mailbox stays with your provider.

Your upstream login details are encrypted with your public key. The private key is locked with your Maskwire password. When your mail app logs into an IMAP or SMTP session, that password unlocks the credentials so Maskwire can connect on your behalf. Stored credentials alone cannot unlock your mailbox.

Maskwire can process email during that session. This protects stored credentials; it is not end-to-end encryption of email content.

# Maskwire

A transparent email proxy for power users

🌐 Open on Web

In my blog Join the Discord

Maskwire is a transparent email proxy that enhances existing email services with additional power-user features. It sits between your email client and provider, adding capabilities like seamless alias replies, customizable actions, smart sender selection, and inbox filtering, all without changing how you use email.

## Key Features

✓

Reply Seamlessly: Automatically reply from the correct alias (e.g., [email protected]) without manual switching.

✓

Customize Actions: Make your email client behave consistently. For example, always archive emails instead of deleting them, regardless of the client’s default swipe action.

✓

Smart Sender Selection: Automatically use designated email addresses when composing new emails based on context.

✓

Control Your Inbox Size: Sync only recent emails (e.g., the last 30 days) to your client, keeping it fast and lean.

✓

Works Everywhere: Use Maskwire with any standard email client and provider that supports IMAP/SMTP.

✓

Secure by Design: Your email provider credentials are encrypted using a key only you possess.
